comment: How long, in minutes, an admin account stays locked after too many failed logins.
modal: The duration, in minutes, that an admin account is locked once the failed-login limit is reached, after which sign-in is allowed again.

comment: Whether a periodic admin password change is forced or only recommended.
modal: Chooses whether admins are required to change their password once the password lifetime elapses, or merely prompted to. Governs how the password-expiry policy is applied.
